[[Exuro Flatus]] is a [[Titan]] [[boss]] that appears in the [[Domain of Secrets]].

== Locations ==
* [[Realm of Torment]]
** {{NPC location|Domain of Secrets}}

== Skills ==
* {{skill icon|Fire Attunement}}
* {{skill icon|Fireball}}
* {{skill icon|Immolate}}
* {{skill icon|Mind Blast}} ([[elite]])

== Items dropped ==
* [[Exuro's Will]] ([[unique]])

== Notes ==
{{bug|
*Sometimes Exuro Flatus will become passive (stop [[attack]]ing or casting offensive [[spell]]s) for short periods of time.
*Exuro Flatus cannot attack.}}

*If leaving from the [[Gate of Madness (outpost)|Gate of Madness]], beware as you can immediately [[aggro]] a group of Shadow Army foes.
*A group of Shadow Army foes can walk within Exuro's area, making [[farming]] difficult.

== Trivia ==
* The name means "Burning Blast" in Latin.
* The icon for the [[elite skill]] of this boss resembles the unique item it drops.
